decision.explanation: The headphones were delivered 2 days ago and are damaged. The return window for electronics is 7 days, so the item is eligible for a return. Item price is ₹2499 plus shipping ₹49 for total ₹2548 refund after pickup. Photo evidence is not mandatory as item value is above ₹2000 but no photo was uploaded, still the policy allows return scheduling here with refund after pickup. The refund is to original payment method UPI. Return scheduled; refund will process after pickup completion.
